bug_semantics: Clatter exposed post-quantum PSK0 handshake patterns without enforcing the Noise PSK validity rule. In the affected patterns, PSK-derived cipher state could be used before the sending party had contributed fresh self-chosen ephemeral randomness, so repeated or attacker-influenced handshakes could lose the intended key-randomization guarantee and risk catastrophic key reuse.
flaw_origin: Commit 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d introduced PSK support, a public add_psks helper that accepted arbitrary placements without a validity check, and the four advisory-named PQ patterns noise_pqnn_psk0, noise_pqnk_psk0, noise_pqkn_psk0, and noise_pqkk_psk0. Commit 41ffa78dec758c4f6c316a3d5c07a43c584ea00f later reused that already-unsafe helper for the affected hybridNKpsk0 and hybridKKpsk0 variants; the earliest common flawed mechanism and the four original vulnerable defaults therefore originate in 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d.
ai_marker: absent: the raw commit object for 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d names Joni Lepistö <joni.m.lepisto@gmail.com> as both author and committer and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer
evidence: GitHub vendor advisory https://github.com/jmlepisto/clatter/security/advisories/GHSA-253q-9q78-63x4 identifies affected versions < 2.2.0, patched version 2.2.0, the four PQ *_psk0 defaults plus hybrid variants, and the failure to randomize PSK-derived encryption with self-chosen ephemeral randomness.

The official CVE Services record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-24785 reports state PUBLISHED, product jmlepisto/clatter, affected range < 2.2.0, and cites both the vendor advisory and fix commit b65ae6e9b8019bed5407771e21f89ddff17c5a71; it is not rejected or withdrawn.

git log --all --reverse -S searches for noise_pqnn_psk0, noise_pqnk_psk0, noise_pqkn_psk0, and noise_pqkk_psk0 all first identify 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d (PSK support), then their removal in b65ae6e9b8019bed5407771e21f89ddff17c5a71.

git diff f715b40a17e51a2dc00ce95a33735c48834d3939 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d -- src/handshakepattern.rs shows the first Token::Psk, unchecked HandshakePattern::add_psks, and all four named PQ PSK0 constructors; git show f715b40a17e51a2dc00ce95a33735c48834d3939:src/handshakepattern.rs contains none of Token::Psk, add_psks, or those constructors.

git cat-file -p 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d proves a single parent f715b40a17e51a2dc00ce95a33735c48834d3939 and the same human author/committer with no trailers, so this is a directly inspectable atomic public commit rather than a merge or an unresolved squash aggregate.

git log -S for noise_hybrid_nk_psk0 and noise_hybrid_kk_psk0 first identifies 41ffa78dec758c4f6c316a3d5c07a43c584ea00f; its parent 7f72da80d4e5addac6bfb2b53d3f0b295ef82ae7 lacks both functions, while the commit adds both by calling the unchecked add_psks helper introduced by 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d.

git show 0fb7a00c0a64a4d4c53bf3319ace8385e4babb87:src/handshakepattern.rs still contains unchecked add_psks and all six offending PQ/hybrid PSK0 defaults. The direct child b65ae6e9b8019bed5407771e21f89ddff17c5a71 adds validate_psk_rule calls to pattern construction and removes those six defaults.

Tag ancestry checks show 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d is absent from clatter-v0.1.1-alpha and present from clatter-v0.1.2-alpha onward; b65ae6e9b8019bed5407771e21f89ddff17c5a71 is absent from affected clatter-v2.1.0 and contained by patched clatter-v2.2.0 (tag commit 1e991cf72ee1396c66e62746e6d10700aa1a5270).
reasoning: The advisory describes a real protocol-compliance flaw rather than a rejected report. Repository history places the first unsafe PSK construction surface and all four named PQ defaults in one non-merge commit, 6453c23382cba8255d489325173174943af5e66d; direct inspection of its immediate parent confirms that the relevant PSK token, helper, and constructors did not exist there. The later hybrid commit only extends the same unchecked construction mechanism and is separately parent-verified. The advisory-linked commit b65ae6e9b8019bed5407771e21f89ddff17c5a71 directly closes both paths by enforcing the PSK rule at construction and removing the invalid built-ins, and its ancestry matches the 2.2.0 patched boundary. Because the BIC commit object has human author and committer identities and no AI authorship marker, the vulnerability is NOT_AI even though the frozen selection had an unrelated repository-level AI-commit signal.
